item.title: Ep. 2 - Mission, Vision, Blah blah blah - The Podcaster's Warehouse
item.description: Missions, visions - everyone’s got one. But does any of it matter? Or do they all stink? Join the guys as they talk everything from moon landings to company standings.

item.title: Ep. 3 - Just Because You Can… - The Podcaster's Warehouse
item.description: Just because something is legal, does that make it okay? Can you keep your values and still succeed? Do any of us really know what our values are? Mike & Nate tackle all that and more on this episode of Take It Offline.

item.title: Ep. 4 - File It Or Flush It! - The Podcaster's Warehouse
item.description: Leadership cliches. They’re infinitely quotable and often motivational. But are they actually factual? The studio heats up as Mike & Nate offer their HOT takes. Join us, won’t you?

item.title: Episode 1 : Therefore, the B - The Podcaster's Warehouse
item.description: Guess what? We're back! We are excited to return and to talk about some of the things we missed in the last few years. There is also discussion about our new production staff and what made the show return. We also dissect Chalamet (not literally) and we do our own 'In Memoriam" segment. Plus, who the heck is Ed Sullivan?

item.title: Episode 2 : To Annoy People for Eternity - The Podcaster's Warehouse
item.description: Tony and Gary are great friends... so why does Mrs. Perkins want them to fight? We take a moment to remember Chuck Norris, Gary's nose, shut-ins, and Tony's love of sugar. Robb and Josh stop by (but only briefly... don't worry) and T and G discus supermarket stressors... you see what I'm sayin'?

item.title: Ep. 5 - Burn[out] After Reading - The Podcaster's Warehouse
item.description: Burnout. Is it real? Or is it simply good, ol’ fashioned, everyday workplace stress? Mike & Nate dig into the research and explore the most current trends. (And how modern work culture may have blurred the lines.) It’s Part 1 of our first-ever two-part episode this week on Take It Offline.

item.title: Episode 3 : That Will Cost You Extra - The Podcaster's Warehouse
item.description: We're back with a new theme! Again! Tune in for a remarkable story about the way things worked at GMA on the 6th floor. Who was your first celebrity crush? Our answers may surprise you. We also discuss the worst movie sequels. Plus, snooze buttons and noses!
